notes.title: Change Log 1-3-2023
notes.content:
- Changed broken nets to count towards the total net amount
- Broken nets can now be placed back into the water like a normal net
- Added boat capacity for nets (currently 10 max)
- Fixed net catching infinitely
- Fixed "New" button not removing old save
- Fixed rope not showing inbetween net buoys
- Decreased net Catch Rate
- Fixed VSync not saving
- Fixed net capacity
- Fixed nets catching too fast when near each other
- Decreased catch rate for nets
- Fixed nets not catching after loading save
- Remove unnecessary files

notes.title: Change Log 26-2-2023
notes.content:
[b]MAP UPDATES:[/b]
- New Map/Island
- Updated Water
- Updated Foliage
- New Cel Shader
- New Lighting
- Added Crickets
- Added Day/Night Cycle

[b]BOAT UPDATES:[/b]
- Broken Nets can be replaced for half the price
- Added Save Game (Does not save spawned net info, only location)
- Added Wake Effect
- Changed Rope Texture for Buoys
- Net Catch Rate decreases if they are close to each other
- Trying out waypoints (currently for shop only)
- Changed Net Pickup (E when in range)
- Changed Movement (Slower Reverse, Wider Turning, Faster Braking)

[b]HUD UPDATES:[/b]
- Added Main Menu
- Added Loading Screen
- Updated Net HUD
- Updated Player HUD
- Updated Pause Menu
- Removed Radar
- Added Minimap
- Added Cheat Panel (ALT+SHIFT+Z) (Unfinished but works)
- Moved Fuel Buying to Upgrade Shop
- Added Reflection Settings
- Added Color to FPS
- Added Big Map (Hold TAB)
- Added Volume Slider (Broken for engine sound)

[b]USELESS UPDATES:[/b]
- Cleaned Up Player Blueprint
- Changed Game Icon
